[[aou-6-integration-guide]]
== 6. Integration guide

The details of integration for AOU_CORE are provided in this section. Number of AXI channels is configurable: the [.monospaced]#++RP_COUNT++# parameter defaults to 1 and is parameterizable up to 4. The I/O description in xref:aou-61-io-descriptions[Section 6.1] is shown for an example [.monospaced]#++RP_COUNT = 2++# configuration.

The AoU IP can be integrated either at [.monospaced]#++AOU_CORE_TOP++# (the module documented in this MAS) or at the higher-level [.monospaced]#++AOU_TOP++# wrapper, which adds the [.monospaced]#++AOU_FDI_BRINGUP_CTRL++# block for turn-key UCIe FDI bringup. Both top modules share the same AXI, APB, FDI data-plane, interrupt, and DFT interfaces and forward the same [.monospaced]#++FDI_CONFIG++# parameter (see xref:aou-64-configurable-parameters[Section 6.4]) through to AOU_CORE. For a side-by-side comparison of the two integration options see the companion _AOU Integration Guide_ (link:../integration_guide/integration_guide.md[DOC/integration_guide/integration_guide.md]). The remainder of this MAS scopes itself to [.monospaced]#++AOU_CORE_TOP++#.

_Table 5. AOU_CORE_TOP Interface_

*[Activation related signal]*

* *I_INT_FSM_IN_ACTIVE* is an input signal that indicates that the link up is complete. When starting the test, I_INT_FSM_IN_ACTIVE should be 0, and when you want to activate AOU_CORE, I_INT_FSM_IN_ACTIVE should be 1. When testing with IP standalone, you must force I_INT_FSM_IN_ACTIVE.
* *I_MST_BUS_CLEANY_COMPLETE* (signal of AOU_CORE_TOP) is asserted when all responses to the remote diepass:[']s requests have been completed. The signal originates from the BUS_CLEANY. If the BUS_CLEANY feature is not used, the corresponding port must be tied to 1.
* *I_SLV_BUS_CLEANY_COMPLETE* is asserted when all responses from the remote die have been received for the requests sent by the local die. The signal originates from the BUS_CLEANY. If the BUS_CLEANY feature is not used, the corresponding port must be tied to 1.
* After AOU_CORE deactivation, the activation status transitions to DISABLED, allowing the UCIe link to go down. Once deactivation completes, the *O_AOU_ACTIVATE_ST_DISABLED* (signal of AOU_CORE_TOP) is asserted to notify the UCIE_CORE.
* When the AOU_CORE is in the ENABLED state, *O_AOU_ACTIVATE_ST_ENABLED* is asserted to notify the UCIE_CORE.
* *O_AOU_REQ_LINKRESET* is a signal that is asserted together with INT_REQ_LINKRESET when the AOU_CORE detects an AoU protocol violation. O_AOU_REQ_LINKRESET is used to notify the UCIE_CORE.

[[aou-64-configurable-parameters]]
=== 6.4. Configurable Parameters

[[table-6]]

[cols="a,a,a"]
|===
a|*Name*
a|*Values*
a|*Note*

a|RP_COUNT
a|1
a|Equal to the count of RP. Default 1; parameterizable up to 4.

a|FDI_CONFIG
a|FDI_CFG_SP_32B
a|FDI width selector. Single integer parameter (named constants in
[.monospaced]#++RTL/packet_def_pkg.sv++#) replacing the legacy
[.monospaced]#++FDI_IF_WD0++#/[.monospaced]#++FDI_IF_WD1++# width pair. +

Valid values: +

pass:[-] [.monospaced]#++FDI_CFG_SP_32B++# (0) - single PHY, WD0=256, WD1=512 (internal decode) +

pass:[-] [.monospaced]#++FDI_CFG_SP_64B++# (1) - single PHY, WD0=512, WD1=512 (internal decode) +

pass:[-] [.monospaced]#++FDI_CFG_SP_128B++# (2) - single PHY, WD0=1024, WD1=1024 (internal decode) +

pass:[-] [.monospaced]#++FDI_CFG_TP_32B_64B++# (3) - two PHY, WD0=256, WD1=512 (requires [.monospaced]#pass:c[+define+TWO_PHY]#) +

pass:[-] [.monospaced]#++FDI_CFG_TP_64B_128B++# (4) - two PHY, WD0=512, WD1=1024 (requires [.monospaced]#pass:c[+define+TWO_PHY]#) +

The two-PHY values are valid only with the [.monospaced]#pass:c[+define+TWO_PHY]# build flag, which gates the
physical presence of the PHY1 ports and the [.monospaced]#++I_PHY_TYPE++# selector. Consistency between
[.monospaced]#++FDI_CONFIG++# and [.monospaced]#pass:c[+define+TWO_PHY]# is the integratorpass:[']s responsibility; no in-RTL
elaboration check is added.

a|RP*_AXI_DATA_WD
a|512
a|Equal to the bus data width.

a|AXI_PEER_DIE_MAX_DATA_WD
a|1024
a|Maximum data width sent by the remote
die. Fixed to 1024.

a|RP*_RX_AW_FIFO_DEPTH
a|44
a|FIFO Depth for storing
messages received from the remote die.
The RX FIFO DEPTH should be determined by considering the
Turn-Around-Time(TAT) between the local die and the remote die, so that
no performance drop occurs due to AoU. +

TAT refers to the time in an environment integrated with UCIe, measured
from when the local die sends a message until the credit is received
back from the remote die. +

The [.monospaced]#++RP*_RX_W_FIFO_DEPTH++# and [.monospaced]#++RP*_RX_R_FIFO_DEPTH++# defaults are FDI-config aware:
140 entries when [.monospaced]#++FDI_CONFIG++# selects a 1024b interface ([.monospaced]#++FDI_CFG_SP_128B++# or
[.monospaced]#++FDI_CFG_TP_64B_128B++#); 88 entries otherwise.

a|RP*_RX_AR_FIFO_DEPTH
a|44
a|

a|RP*_RX_W_FIFO_DEPTH
a|88 / 140
a|

a|RP*_RX_R_FIFO_DEPTH
a|88 / 140
a|

a|RP*_RX_B_FIFO_DEPTH
a|44
a|

a|RX_AW_FIFO_RS_EN
a|1
a|When 1, inserts an output register-slice on the corresponding RX FIFO read
port. Trades latency (+1 cycle) for timing closure on the AXI manager
output paths. Independently controllable per channel
(AW / AR / W / R / B).

a|RX_AR_FIFO_RS_EN
a|1
a|

a|RX_W_FIFO_RS_EN
a|1
a|

a|RX_R_FIFO_RS_EN
a|1
a|

a|RX_B_FIFO_RS_EN
a|1
a|

a|APB_ADDR_WD
a|32
a|APB Address width.

a|APB_DATA_WD
a|32
a|APB data width.

a|S_RD_MO_CNT
a|32
a|Subordinate Read Multiple Outstanding Count.
It refers to the number of table entries used to record information
about requests received from the local die.

a|S_WR_MO_CNT
a|32
a|Subordinate Write Multiple Outstanding Count.
It refers to the number of table entries used to record information
about requests received from the local die.

a|M_RD_MO_CNT
a|32
a|Manager Read Multiple Outstanding Count.
It refers to the number of table entries used to record information
about requests received from the remote die.

a|M_WR_MO_CNT
a|32
a|Manager Write Multiple Outstanding Count.
It refers to the number of table entries used to record information
about requests received from the remote die.

|Flag |Effect
|[.monospaced]#pass:c[+define+TWO_PHY]# |Compile-time switch that adds the second-PHY ports ([.monospaced]#++I_FDI_PL_1_*++#, [.monospaced]#++O_FDI_LP_1_*++#) and the [.monospaced]#++I_PHY_TYPE++# selector to both [.monospaced]#++AOU_CORE_TOP++# and [.monospaced]#++AOU_TOP++#. Required for the [.monospaced]#++FDI_CFG_TP_*++# values of [.monospaced]#++FDI_CONFIG++#.
|==================================================================================================================================================================================================================================
